title: Hippocrates Wellness: Anna Maria Clement and Jeffrey M Smith
excerpt: Hippocrates Wellness's Anna Maria Clement discusses the impact of Genetically Modified Organisms in our food supply with author Jeffrey M Smith.
content: Hippocrates Wellness's Anna Maria Clement discusses the impact of Genetically Modified Organisms in our food supply with author Jeffrey M Smith. http://hippocratesinst.org/ A vibrant raw, living foods diet is the cornerstone of the Life Transformation Program at HHI and we are privileged to have Jeffrey Smith as a guest lecturer periodically.
